title: Consolidated Compliance Validation Matrix for Customer Key Custody & Federated Auth
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a single operational validation matrix and sign-off checklist that certifies a Private/VPC or on-prem deployment meets Redwood's customer-key custody, federated authentication (SAML/OIDC), RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM integration requirements. This ticket consolidates acceptance criteria, required evidence artifacts, and the runbook for verification teams (QA/Platform/Security) to perform deterministic checks prior to customer onboarding.

Scope: verification for Private (VPC and on-prem) only. Includes: inbound SAML/OIDC federation flows, IdP attribute mapping, system-level RBAC enforcement & least-privilege checks, KMS integration (CMEK/HSM key wrap), customer key import/export/escrow path, rotation, and immutable audit logs with tamper evidence. Excludes: hosted API multi-tenant defaults, experimental qps auto-batching tests.

Trade-offs and decisions so far: automated e2e evidence collection (preferred) vs manual signed checklist. We will author a hybrid approach: automated smoke tests + human-reviewed evidence bundle for cryptographic proofs (KMS key IDs, HSM attestation statements). For SAML metadata exchange we require canonicalized metadata files for traceability rather than relying on ad-hoc screenshots.

Acceptance approach: 1) pre-flight self-check (customer-run script) 2) platform verification in staging with seeded IdP/keys 3) on-customer-environment verification with delegated operator-assisted runs and final sign-off recorded in evidence bundle.

Risks: prolonged HSM vendor attestation timelines, variability across customer IdP implementations, and legal constraints for key escrow in certain geographies. Mitigations call out timelines and escalation paths in the checklist.
acceptance_criteria: SSO federation: Successful SAML/OIDC login and token exchange using customer IdP in staging; metadata files archived and hash-summed as evidence
RBAC: Role matrix applied to an example tenant with at least three role levels (admin, operator, observer) and proof of enforcement (API response logs showing allowed/denied actions)

Audit logging: Immutable audit stream enabled, with tamper-evidence; audit export contains timestamped events for identity and key management actions and verifies retention policy (30/90/365 day variants)
KMS/HSM: CMEK key used for disk/secret encryption in the deployment; HSM attestation or KMS key policy evidence included; key rotation executed and validated end-to-end
Key custody: Customer key import/export flows documented and executed in a test import with escrow manifest produced and validated by Security
Operator runbook & rollback: A validated runbook for emergency key revocation and fallback to Redwood-managed keys exists and has been exercised in staging
Telemetry & alerts: Observability configured to surface SSO failures, key access errors, and audit-sink delivery failures; alerting rules exercised via synthetic failures

Evidence bundle: A single deployable artifact (tar.gz) containing logs, metadata, test outputs, and signed attestations is produced and uploaded to the secure audit bucket; hash and access policy captured in the ticket
